author: vderoy
title: Nice but rakes way too long to synchronise library
content: Overall this is a very nice app, lots of settings, Equalizer and good looking UI. The downside is it takes forever to synchronise the music library, which makes the app useless for me. Even overnight it got only 90 albums from my cloud storage service (not downloading, only getting metadata). Other, similar apps have my complete library ready in 5 minutes... Too bad.
